# Digicrome

Digicrome Pvt Ltd is an India-based EdTech company offering job-ready online courses, certification programs, and placement-focused training in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Full Stack Development, Cloud Computing, UI/UX Design, and related technology domains.

Founded in 2017, Digicrome provides live online and classroom learning programs for students, freshers, and working professionals. The platform focuses on hands-on learning, mentorship, industry projects, internship opportunities, and career support.

Website: https://www.digicrome.com

Email: info@digicrome.com

Phone: +91-0120-4538104

Address: B-49, First Floor, Block B, Sector 59, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India
